meta.row_unit: one row per (notes table row x emotion combination listed as supported / not supported, or named in the row x mapped activity id)

outcome_values.both_improved: every emotion of the combination improved in the same study row (for a pair listed under combination_pairs_supported, or a combination row whose finding says so)
outcome_values.one_not_improved: one emotion improved, the other was measured and did not improve (ns), or was not reported as changed
outcome_values.one_worsened: at least one emotion of the combination got worse; the activity is excluded for that combination in the matrix
outcome_values.neither_improved: both emotions measured, neither improved (or neither beat the comparator)
outcome_values.mixed: changes in both directions, or the result depends on a moderator, framing or comparator
outcome_values.single_emotion_only: only one emotion of the combination was measured; the row is linked to the combination through a rule (evidence_basis single_emotion_extrapolation)
outcome_values.proxy_outcome: the outcome is a mechanism or proxy (detachment, recovery, performance, perceived support), not the emotions themselves
outcome_values.association_only: correlational, diary or rating evidence; no change was tested
outcome_values.general_principle: a regulation principle for any mixed state; not tied to a specific combination

meta.note: Effects are copied verbatim from the notes. combo_weight = tag x design x evidence_basis x mapping (see schema.md); it orders evidence, it is not an effect size.
